pair.searchQuery: Seed/Series A fintech founders (DeFi, embedded finance, payments) with strong technical co-founders & regulatory understanding – looking to advise on scaling, not just fundraising. Based anywhere.

userContactFile.positioning: Beatriz Weber is a seasoned operating advisor and angel investor specializing in the fintech landscape. Having successfully navigated the complexities of regulatory compliance and rapid scaling with her previous company, I now dedicate my time to helping early-stage founders build sustainable and impactful businesses. My expertise lies in streamlining go-to-market strategies, navigating the evolving regulatory environment, and establishing robust operational foundations. I’m currently advising three Seed-stage companies focused on DeFi and embedded finance solutions, and actively seeking new opportunities to leverage my experience. I’m particularly keen to connect with founders tackling pain points in the financial infrastructure space and investors seeking insights into emerging fintech trends.
userContactFile.lookingFor:
• Introductions to Seed & Series A fintech founders (DeFi, embedded finance, payments infrastructure preferred).
• Connections to VCs specializing in early-stage fintech investments (Series A, Seed).
• Opportunities to share insights on regulatory compliance in the crypto space.
• Potential co-investors for angel investments ($25k - $100k).
• Founders seeking advice on scaling operations and go-to-market strategy.
• Do NOT introduce me to projects lacking a clear path to profitability.
• Do NOT pitch me NFT projects or Web3 ventures without demonstrable utility.
• Warm introductions only – cold emails are immediately deleted.
userContactFile.introPreferences:
• **Hard Requirement:** Founders *must* have a strong technical co-founder and a demonstrable understanding of the regulatory landscape.
• **Soft Preference:** I prefer founders who have previously built and scaled a successful technology product.
• **Intro Style:** Please provide a concise summary of the company, the problem they're solving, and the founder's background. Highlight any relevant experience in fintech or regulatory compliance. 
• **Do NOT:** Send me a lengthy pitch deck without a brief introductory email. I don't have time to sift through irrelevant information.
• **Do NOT:** Introduce me to founders who are solely focused on fundraising – I'm looking for partners, not clients.
• I respond best to introductions that clearly articulate *why* this connection would be mutually beneficial.
userContactFile.personalPreferences: Prefers direct communication via email or LinkedIn. Avoid lengthy phone calls unless pre-scheduled.
userContactFile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences: I generally prefer 30-minute Zoom meetings. Please use Calendly to schedule a time that works for both of us. I'm typically available between 10 am and 4 pm PST.
userContactFile.background:
• **Founder & CEO, CompliantX (2016 – 2019):** Led the development and launch of a SaaS platform providing automated KYC/AML compliance solutions for cryptocurrency exchanges. Grew revenue from $0 to $8M ARR within 2.5 years. Successfully secured $5M in Series A funding from leading venture capital firms. Oversaw a team of 45 employees across engineering, sales, and customer success. Exited to a publicly traded financial technology company in 2019 for an undisclosed sum.
• **Head of Product, SecurePay (2013 – 2016):** Responsible for the product roadmap and execution of SecurePay’s core payment processing platform. Launched a new mobile payment SDK that increased mobile transaction volume by 30% within the first year. Managed a product team of 10 engineers, designers, and product managers. Collaborated closely with sales and marketing teams to identify and prioritize new product features.
• **Senior Consultant, Deloitte (2010 – 2013):** Advised financial institutions on regulatory compliance and risk management strategies. Led engagements focused on anti-money laundering (AML) and fraud prevention. Developed and implemented compliance programs for clients in the banking and investment management industries. Presented findings and recommendations to senior management teams.
• **Education:** MBA, Stanford Graduate School of Business (2010). BS, Computer Science, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (2008). Graduated *Summa Cum Laude*.
userContactFile.locationAvailability: Based in San Francisco, California. Willing to travel to key fintech hubs (NYC, London) for promising opportunities. Open to remote collaboration with teams globally.
userContactFile.notes: [March 15, 2024] Had a great call with David from FinFlow. Very impressed with his technical background and the team's focus on solving a real problem. Likely to make an angel investment. [Feb 29, 2024] Met Beatriz at the Fintech Forward conference. She's incredibly direct and asks tough questions, but genuinely wants to help. She's a no-nonsense advisor – avoid buzzwords. [Jan 10, 2024] She mentioned she's particularly interested in companies that can help traditional financial institutions integrate with DeFi protocols. Flag this when making intros. She’s very protective of her time and prioritizes quality over quantity. Avoid sending her anything that isn’t thoroughly vetted.

matchContactFile.positioning: As Head of Regulatory Affairs at NovaPay, I lead the charge in navigating the complex and evolving regulatory landscape of the fintech industry. We’re building the next generation of payments infrastructure, enabling businesses to seamlessly integrate financial services into their customer experiences. My focus is on establishing and maintaining robust compliance programs, fostering strong relationships with regulators, and ensuring NovaPay operates with the highest ethical standards. Previously, I spent over a decade in traditional banking, culminating in a VP of Compliance role at First Horizon, where I oversaw a portfolio of regulatory programs and managed a team of compliance professionals. I’m passionate about applying my deep understanding of financial regulations to innovative fintech solutions, and I thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments. I'm particularly interested in the intersection of technology and compliance, specifically in areas like RegTech, AML/KYC, and the future of digital currencies. I’m actively seeking strategic partnerships that will allow NovaPay to expand its reach and impact, and I’m always open to connecting with thought leaders in the fintech and regulatory space. I believe proactive compliance isn't a roadblock to innovation, but a catalyst for sustainable growth.
matchContactFile.lookingFor:
I'm actively expanding my network within the fintech and regulatory communities. I’m particularly interested in connecting with individuals who can contribute to NovaPay’s growth and success. Specifically, I'm looking for:

* **Potential Banking Partners:** Executives at banks (especially those open to embedded finance) with $1B+ in assets, interested in exploring partnership opportunities with a leading payments platform.
* **RegTech Founders/CEOs:** Individuals building innovative solutions for compliance challenges in areas like transaction monitoring, KYC/AML, and fraud prevention. Seed to Series B stage preferred.
* **Regulatory Experts:** Attorneys or consultants specializing in payments, digital assets, and financial regulations. Deep understanding of US and international regulatory frameworks is a plus.
* **Early-Stage Fintech Founders:** Founders of pre-seed to Series A fintech companies facing regulatory hurdles. I'm open to offering advice and mentorship, particularly in the areas of compliance and bank partnerships.

I’m *not* currently looking for sales pitches or unsolicited services. I value genuine connections and collaborative discussions. I’m happy to share my expertise and learn from others, but I prioritize quality over quantity in my network.
matchContactFile.introPreferences:
* Introductions should be concise and highlight the potential mutual benefit. 
* Please include a brief summary of the individual’s expertise and relevant experience. 
* Avoid lengthy emails or overly promotional language. 
* Minimum check size for RegTech introductions: $2M Series A. 
* For potential banking partners, please pre-qualify their interest in embedded finance solutions. 
* Preferred communication method for initial outreach is LinkedIn message, followed by email. 
* Do *not* forward his email without his explicit permission.
matchContactFile.personalPreferences: Enjoys a good single malt scotch and discussing Japanese art. Doesn’t check email religiously on weekends.
matchContactFile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences:
* Prefers 30-minute introductory calls. 
* Availability is limited, so please provide several proposed times. 
* Generally avoids meetings before 9:00 AM or after 5:00 PM EST.
matchContactFile.background:
- **NovaPay, Head of Regulatory Affairs** (January 2022 – Present)
  * Developed and implemented a comprehensive regulatory compliance program for a rapidly scaling payments platform, covering AML/KYC, fraud prevention, and data privacy.
  * Led negotiations with potential banking partners, ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations and agreements.
  * Managed a team of compliance analysts and specialists, providing guidance and mentorship.
  * Successfully navigated several regulatory audits with zero material findings.
  * Spearheaded the company's response to emerging regulatory requirements related to stablecoins and real-time payments.

- **First Horizon Bank, Vice President of Compliance** (June 2015 – December 2021)
  * Managed a portfolio of regulatory programs, including BSA/AML, OFAC, and consumer protection.
  * Led a team of 15+ compliance professionals, responsible for monitoring and reporting on compliance risks.
  * Developed and delivered compliance training programs to employees across the organization.
  * Implemented new technologies to enhance compliance monitoring and reporting capabilities, resulting in a 20% reduction in manual review time.
  * Served as a key point of contact for regulatory examinations and inquiries.

- **PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC), Senior Associate, Financial Crimes Unit** (August 2012 – May 2015)
  * Conducted risk assessments and investigations related to money laundering, fraud, and other financial crimes.
  * Assisted clients in developing and implementing AML/KYC compliance programs.
  * Prepared reports and presentations for clients and regulatory agencies.

- **Vanderbilt University, Bachelor of Arts, Economics & East Asian Studies (Japanese Art History Minor)** (August 2008 – May 2012)
  * Graduated *cum laude* with a double major in Economics and East Asian Studies.
matchContactFile.locationAvailability: Based in New York City, with frequent travel to San Francisco and Washington D.C.
matchContactFile.notes:
* Priority: Secure partnerships with 2-3 strategic banking partners in the next 6 months.
* Caveat: Javier is extremely busy and responds slowly to cold outreach. Warm introductions are *highly* preferred.
* Signal: He's a big proponent of proactive compliance and views it as a competitive advantage.
* Context: Recently presented at a fintech compliance conference on the future of stablecoin regulation. He’s considered a rising star in the space.
* Reminder: He's a surprisingly knowledgeable collector of Japanese woodblock prints – a great conversation starter.

qc.judge_reasoning: Beatriz is an investor and advisor looking for early-stage founders to mentor, while Javier is a Head of Regulatory Affairs at a scaling fintech company looking for strategic connections and regulatory expertise. While they are not a perfect founder-investor match, they are both high-level experts in fintech compliance and regulatory strategy who would find significant value in a peer-to-peer professional connection. Their shared focus on the intersection of technology and regulation makes this a strong networking match for knowledge exchange and potential future collaboration.
